help_guide.title: Gufasha no gufasha
help_guide.subtitle: Kuba uyuze mu kugaruka, ugaruka, no kureba kuri Dueli — kandi ibisubizo ku byegeranyo.
help_guide.overview_d: Gukira umugaruka, umukino we ujye mu mukino we, ukina kuri interineti, uhereye ibisubizo n'ibyanditswe ku mugaruka w'umugaruka.
help_guide.creator_s1d: Gufungura Gukira, hita icyegeranyo n'icyegeranyo cy'icyegeranyo, andika amabwiriza, kandi iyo uhitamo, hita igihe. Umugaruka utangira nk'umugaruka ugiye kuba kugeza umukino ujye.
help_guide.creator_s2d: Tumira ikitezwe ku mugaruka w'umugaruka cyangwa subira mu Ibyishimo byanjye. Ikitezwe gikurikira kwinjira mu mugaruka kwa we, n'umukino wumwanya wumukino utangira.
help_guide.creator_s3d: Gukina igihe umuwe wose ugiye kuba, n'umugaruka ukangiza kubera seriveri. Nyuma y'umugaruka, ibyishimo byangira byose, n'ibisubizo byangira byose.
help_guide.opponent_s1d: Gushakisha mu Gushaka umugaruka ugiye kuba, cyangwa ufungura ikitezwe mu Ibyishimo byanjye. Subira cyangwa umvise ku mugaruka w'umugaruka; ikitezwe kirekire nyuma y'amasaha 24.
help_guide.opponent_s2d: Subira mu mugaruka w'umugaruka utangiye. Gukorera seriveri, microphone, n'umurikirano, n'ukoresheza umurikirano iyo ibyishimo byangirira.
help_guide.opponent_s3d: Soma ibisubizo byumwanya ku mugaruka w'umugaruka. Iyo ibyanditswe byariho, byerekana hano; umugaruka utangira utari ibyanditswe urekana ibisubiso.
help_guide.viewer_s1d: Funga umugaruka ugiye kuba ku Nyuma cyangwa Gushakisha. Aba muheri bishobora kumenyekana mu gihe umugaruka utangira.
help_guide.viewer_s2d: Nyuma y'amasaha 5 by'umwanya w'umugaruka, uwuwe kumenyekana umukino we 1–5. Uyuwe kumenyekana we umukino we, umenyesha ibyishimo kugeza umugaruka utangira, n'ibyishimo byangira byose.
help_guide.viewer_s3d: Andika Ibyishimo cyangwa Ibyishimo (umurikirano umwe — umurikirano utagira umurongo), umenyesha abashyitsi kubishyatsi byabo, n'umurikirano nyuma y'umugaruka.
help_guide.topic_create_d: Izina, icyegeranyo, amabwiriza, n'igihembo. Umugaruka ugiye kuba utangira kugeza umukino ujye; umugaruka utangira utagira umukino.
help_guide.topic_invite_d: Ikitezwe gikurikira kwinjira mu mugaruka, n'ibyishimo by'injira by'umukino. Subira cyangwa umvise ku mugaruka w'umugaruka; ibyishimo byangira byose byongera umugaruka.
help_guide.topic_live_d: Umugaruka urekana umwanya, umukino, ikosa, umurikirano, ugiye kuba, cyangwa utariho. Umwanya utagira umugaruka; iyo ikosa, ukoresheza umurikirano.
help_guide.topic_recording_d: Umugaruka utangira n'ibyanditswe byose byerekana kubishyatsi byabo. Umugaruka utangira utari ibyanditswe urekana ibisubiso.
help_guide.topic_ratings_d: Ibyishimo byose byangira kugeza umugaruka utangira; umukino we 1–5, ibisubizo byahinduka, kandi ibyishimo byose byangira.
help_guide.topic_reactions_d: Umurikirano umwe: ibyishimo, ibyishimo, cyangwa utariho. Umurikirano utagira umurongo.
help_guide.topic_comments_d: Ibyishimo byose byangira nyuma y'umugaruka. Ibyishimo by'umugaruka byerekana umwanya w'umugaruka, byerekana mu gihe umugaruka utangira, n'ibyishimo byose byangira byose.
help_guide.topic_discover_d: Gushakisha mu Gushaka icyegeranyo, icyegeranyo, imyanya, n'ururimi; ibishyitsi byerekana icyegeranyo. Gufata icyegeranyo mu Ibyishimo byanjye.
help_guide.topic_payout_d: Gufata amafaranga mu Mahabeshi n'hitamo umwe ukira amafaranga; umwanya w'amafaranga utangira. Ibyishimo byose byangira byose byerekana mu Ibyishimo byanjye.
help_guide.topic_support_d: Gukora Umurikirano mu menyu kugira ngo ufungire umurikirano; ibisubizo byose byerekana Dueli, nti umurikirano. Subira mu Ibyishimo by'ibyishimo byose byose byerekana mu Ibyishimo byanjye.
help_guide.faq_a1: Subira mu Gukira, andika izina, icyegeranyo, n'amabwiriza, tumira umukino wumukino. Reba amabwiriza ya Umwanditsi hejuru.
help_guide.faq_a2: Uyuwe wumwe umukino wumukino wumukino, umukino wumukino wumukino, cyangwa umukino utangira. Umugaruka w'umugaruka werekana icyo kibazo.
help_guide.faq_a3: Nyuma amasaka 30 yo kureba mu gihe gikuru mu gikombe gicyo.卡拉 ya garagiza iboneza kuba wizeye.
help_guide.faq_a4: Yego — kugeza igihe gikuru gikomeza. Gushaka kenshi bigiraho ibyabonetse, n'umurikikiranywe w'umurongo uhinduka igice cy'umwanya kugeza igihe cy'umwanya.
help_guide.faq_a5: Ikombe ryarangiye. Garagiza zifungurwa igihe gikuru gikomeza, n'umurikikiranywe w'umurongo, harimo no gukumana, zihinduka.
help_guide.faq_a6: Kumurikikiranywe w'ikombe, iyo ireba rigira umurikikiranywe. Nta murikikiranywe, umurikikiranywe ugaragiza umurongo utagira umurikikiranywe.
help_guide.faq_q7: Ibyo byose bya Kira na Nta Kira bya?
help_guide.faq_a7: Ni ibisubizo by'ibintu n'umurongo umwe w'umuntu. Gusubiramo ntibyongera.
help_guide.faq_a8: Ongera uboneza mu mafaranga mu By'amafaranga, hanyuma uyisobanure iyo utegereza gukuramo. Utegerezwa ukuramo umurikikiranywe w'ibyerekeye uboneza.
help_guide.faq_a9: Umurikikiranywe w'amayera ugaragiza amayera nk'ibintu bitagire kurengera. Amayera yawe aragenda hejuru ya Amayera Yange.
help_guide.faq_q10: Ndashobora guhura na muntu w'ubushakashatsi cyangwa guhemba?
help_guide.faq_a10: Gukora Gusaba Umuyobozi kwa ibyemezo by'umuyobozi, Gushyira ahagaragara kwa ibyemezo, n'Amahamya Yange kugira ngo uyobore.
help_guide.access_d: Byose By'amahugurwa byakora ne ishyi: Tab ikomeza, Enter yinjiza, Escape ishira amahugurwa. Kugabaniza kugabaniza kigiraho, Kinyarwanda ibyerekeranye n'ibumoso, n'Igishushu ibyerekeranye n'iburyo. Ibyo byose byose byumvise, uhuye umuyobozi mu menyu.

message_content.slogan: Kuzamura, Kumenya, Kureka, no Kuba umukorerabushake
message_content.identity: Dueli ni platformu y'icyumweru yambere yashinzwe kugira ngo iboneza kuri 100% gahunda z'umurikirane z'umurikirane zose, zihoraho, n'izihariye mu bihugu byose. Byashinzwe kandi bikurikirwa na Maelsh Pro nk'umushinga w'ubutabera udaharanira inyungu, Dueli igamije guhindura amakimbirane mu ijwi ryo gukina, guhindura ibitekerezo, no kugaragaza impano z'abantu mu buryo buhoraho, buhagarara imbere gahunda z'ubuzima.

pillars.title: Gukuraho Ubutabera n'Ubumenyi kugira ngo Buri wese Abone (Kumenyekana)
pillars.body: Gukuraho ibyemezo by'ubumenyi, ibitekerezo, n'ubuhanzi mu bantu benshi mu isi mu gukina mu buryo buhoraho, kugira ngo ubumenyi buhoraho bukuremeze kandi bukorerwe mu ndimi zose.

pillars.title: Kugaragaza Impano no Guhuza Ubutunze n'Abakozi (Kwihanganira)
pillars.body: Kugira ngo buri muntu afite impano n'umutima afite umurongo w'isi wo kugaragaza ubushobozi bwe mu buryo buhoraho. Ibanze ku gutera impano, Dueli ikaba ari umurongo wo kugira abakozi, abayobozi, n'ibigo kugira ngo babone impano z'umurikirane - kugira ngo kongerera ubushobozi bw'abakozi, Dueli ikaba ari umurongo wo kugira abakozi, abayobozi, n'ibigo kugira ngo babone impano z'umurikirane - kongerera ubushobozi bw'umurimo ku isi no kugaragaza umuntu afite impano aho kurema.

pillars.title: Gukuraho Ubucuruzi n'Ubumenyi bwa Platformu (Kwinjiza)
pillars.body: Kubera ko impano z'abantu ni ibintu by'ibanze, 80% by'umurongo w'amafaranga y'ibicuruzira biha abakozi, 20% kikaba kigenda mu bikorwa bya platformu, ubuyobozi, no kurekura.

message_content.ai_bridge_title: Inzira z'ikinyongera za AI zidahinduka zishobora kugira uruhare mu by'ibikorwa by'abantu
message_content.ai_bridge_body: Muri by'ikitegererezo, Dueli ikenera kubaka inzira z'ikinyongera zihendutse zishobora kugira uruhare mu by'ibikorwa by'abantu no mu mibonano myiza y'abantu mu mazingira ahendutse, ahagije kandi ahari ibisobanuro—bigatiza kumenyesha ibikorwa by'ubu by'umutekano cyangwa iby'ifashishwa ry'amafaranga.

ai_content.intro: Ishimire ry'ibyishimo n'ibisobanuro byose, Dueli isaba ibyishimo byose kwa kompanyi z'AI n'ibikoresho byabyo byo kugira abakoresha muri isi hose imyanya myinshi y'abaturage itangira kandi amafaranga y'umwaka, ndetse n'abashyitsi babanje gufasha igice cy'amafaranga yabo. Ibyo byatumye turaba ku iyi models y'ibanze kugira uruhare mu gukora ibisabwa, gukora porogaramu, no gukurikirana ibikoreshe bya porogaramu utabyemereye ibyemezo byihari cyangwa amafaranga aturuka kuri kompanyi. Turabyishimiye kuri kompanyi cyangwa model yose yatumye iyi nsambu ntiyabonetse.

ai_content.additional_intro: Imideri iri kumenyesha kandi yakoreshwemo ku mbuganda y'ibihuje cyangwa ku kiyihe gahunda y'ibyemewe by'abantu bafite ibyishimo:
ai_content.platforms_intro: Imbuganda n'ibidukikije by'ubumenyi by'ubumenyi byashyizeho umurongo kuri iyi myideri:
ai_content.infrastructure_body: Ibyemezo by'ibanze kuri GitHub, umurikirikiri w'inyandiko z'umurikikiri n'ibikorwa byo kugenzura, kandi kuri Cloudflare, umurongo wa gihugu, Workers, Pages na D1 database zihuza platformu.
ai_content.appeal: Tugira umwanya kuri bose bashinzwe imyitwarire n'AI muri isi, kongerera umurongo wa gahunda za mbere kubikorwa by'ibidukikije by'umuryango. Utwo turimo, Dueli ntibyari byabonetse—hamwe, imyitwarire n'ibyemezo byabantu bigira ishingiro ryongera umurava ku isi.
ai_content.disclaimer: Ibi bihugu, imbuganda n'imiteri ibyemezo byabyo byerekeye imyitwarire y'ibikoresho by'umuryango byakoresheje Dueli, ariko ntibishobora kugaragaza ubufatanye bw'ubucuruzi, gahunda yo gushyikiriza, umvikana w'umutima, cyangwa uburenganzira bw'umutima.
ai_content.updates_body: Iyi urutonde ni igice c'inyandiko z'umurikikiri w'platformu. Ibyongerwa cyangwa ibisubiramo byandikwa mu idosiye yashyizwe mu kugenzura (H9), iboneka kuri Documents; ntashyirwa sisitemu y'ibikorwa ishyirwa hanze.

technology_content.intro: Iki cyegereranya kibivuga imyitwarire Dueli ikora, mu gice kimwe: igaragaza mu mico myinshi kubantu bose n'igaragaza mu mico y'ubumenyi k'abashinzwe imyitwarire. Oya imyitwarire itarimo iyo kode isanzwe ikora.
simple_paragraphs: Dueli ikora mu browser kuri murongo wa Cloudflare. Abakora babiri bakenera mu kibanza cy'ikiganiro cya video mu mezi zabo (WebRTC peer-to-peer); iyo murongo uruhitana umurongo w'umurongo, umurongo wa TURN uhindura umurongo.

Mu gihe cy'imikino, browser ikomora ibice byombi by'amafoto y'ikamera mu kimenyetso kimwe kandi ikandika nk'ibice by'imyaka 5. Ibyo bice byoherezwa iyo byatangira, byakenerwa gukorerwa muri urwo rwego, kandi byungurwa mu gahunda yose nyuma y'imikino.

Imikino yanditswe yashobora kwinjizwa nk'idosiye ya MP4. Iyo idosiye yanditshe isabwa guhindurwa, guhindurwa kora mu browser umukinnyi na FFmpeg.wasm, kugira ngo idosiye isohoke kuri serivisi ya hindurisha ishaka hanze.
Ibyemezo bya platformu biri kuri D1, amapage n'API zubakwa na Hono na TypeScript kuri Cloudflare, n'ikoranabuhanga rikoresha Tailwind CSS. Ibyahinduwe byinjira mu kibanza kuri SSE na polling.
engineering_paragraphs: Igikora: Cloudflare Pages/Workers na Hono 4 kuri TypeScript. D1 (SQLite) ni idosiye y'ibyemezo. Vite ikora ibice by'umukinnyi, Tailwind CSS 4 ikorana imyitwarire, esbuild ikora ibice by'umurikikiri w'umukinnyi.

Imikino ishingiye ku myitwarire: RTCPeerConnection mu browser ibera WebRTC hagati y'umukinnyi n'umukinnyi. Serivisi za ICE zashyizwe kuri buri sesoni kuri GET /api/signaling/ice-servers; Cloudflare Calls TURN (TURN_TOKEN_ID na TURN_API_TOKEN) cyangwa coturn yishyizwe mu kazi (TURN_URL na TURN_SECRET) zishobora guhindura, n'ikibazo cya STUN-only iyo ariko ntibyashyizwe.

Gukandika: canvas compositor yerekana ibice byombi, na MediaRecorder yohereza ibice buri myaka 5. Umukinnyi uhuza buri gice kuri POST /api/chunks/register (ikimenyetso gitera igihe gikora kuri imikino, umurongo n'umubare w'ibice), yohereza, yemeza kuri GET /verify na raporo kuri POST /receipt. Gukina ibyereka kuri GET /api/chunks/playlist/:id, na gahunda yo kumurika ikorwa VOD.

Kwinjiza: @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 ikora mu umukinnyi w'umukinnyi w'umurikikiri kuri MP4, n'umurongo wa remux w'ibisobanuro kubanditshe bari MP4. Gukurikira no gukira umurongo byakozwe mu serivisi y'umukinnyi.
Mu gihe: SSE kuri GET /api/sse ibera ibyahinduwe, na signaling ikora polling; umurongo wo kugena ntibikora WebSocket.
Uburinganire: Vitest ikira ibice n'ibisabwa by'umukinnyi, na Playwright ikira ibice by'umukinnyi byose. Idosiye ya Markdown yerekana na marked, na PostCSS na Autoprefixer igira igishushanyo cya CSS.

support_content.intro: Uko platformi yashinzwe, umutungo w'amafaranga y'ibicuruzwa wongerwa, na gahunda yo kurema Dueli nk'umushinga wo gutanga inkunga ku baturage.
support_content.split_80_body: Umurongo w'abakorerabushake ugabanywa hagati y'ibice bya byombi bya gahunda, mu gipimo cy'ibyegeranyo by'ibyishimo by'umurongo wose, na byose igihe ibisubizo ari ibyishimo cyangwa ibyishimo by'imyaka ntibiboneka — byemera igihe cyo kugabanya amafaranga.
support_content.split_20_title: 20% kugira ngo platformi ibe ishingiye, ishingiye no gukora
support_content.split_20_body: Igice cyo kugira ngo platformi ibe ishingiye, ishingiye no gukora. Umurongo w'ibyishimo ukoreshwa mu byemezo bya platformi, na ibyishimo byo kugira ngo byemera byarekwa mu kibazo cy'amafaranga.
support_content.split_note: Iyi ikintu igaragaza imiterere iriho; ntacyo cyemezo cy'amafaranga cyangwa imyaka. Gahunda z'ibikorwa by'umwaka uzaza zishobora kongerwa ku mitungo yatanzwe.

donors.title: Ihebe 1: kureka ibyafashwe
donors.body: Gukurikiza kibazo cy'amafaranga kugira ngo umuntu yibone ibyo birenze no ibyo bishya.

donors.title: Ihebe 2: kugaragaza inkunga y'imyaka
donors.body: Kongera gukoresha inzira y'inkunga y'imyaka ikora no kugaragaza ibyafasha; hatabayeho umuyoboro w'amafaranga mushya kugira ngo ukoreshwe.

donors.title: Ihebe 3: kugaragaza abafasha
donors.body: Niba umurongo w'ibyishimo wongerwa nyuma, uzaboneka mu makuru ashingiye ku byemezo. Iyi ni umurongo, ntacyo cyemezo cy'imyaka.

support_content.donors_note: Iyi ihebe ni umurongo, ntacyo cyemezo cy'imyaka. Iyo umuyoboro w'inkunga w'umwaka uzaza wongerwa, ugomba gukoresha umuyoboro w'amafaranga ukoresha no gushimisha umuyoboro w'amafaranga.
support_content.future_title: Gahunda z'ibikorwa by'umwaka uzaza, ishobora kongerwa ku mitungo
support_content.future_body: Gahunda z'ibikorwa by'umwaka uzaza zashyizwe hanze ziri gukora zishobora kongerwa ku mitungo. Iyo umuyoboro w'amafaranga mushya cyangwa umuyoboro w'amafaranga ntibongerwa, no kubona amafaranga cyangwa imyaka ntacyo cyemezo.
support_content.nonfinancial_title: Inzira yo kunga mu buryo butagira amafaranga
nonfinancial: Hanze igitekerezo abantu bakoresheje, no kumvira inkunga ku gahunda.
Kunga ku bya gahunda byashyizwe hanze, mu myizerere yabyo.
Bivuga ikibazo cyangwa kugira ngo ushyireho ku nzira zo kubona inkunga.
support_content.separation_body: Inkunga ya platformi igenda kuri /donate na ibyishimo byo kugira ngo byemera byabonetse mu /transparency. Amafaranga y'abakorerabushake ava mu gahunda y'uburenganzira, na inkunga ku bakorerabushake ni umurongo utandukanye mu gahunda. Ibyo byombi ntibyongerwa, kandi iyi page itagira umuyoboro w'amafaranga mushya.

charter_content.intro: Iyi page igaragaza amategeko ashingiye ku gahunda ya Dueli: icyemezo cya Maelsh Pro Ethical Source, icyemezo cya self-executing continuity n'umutungo w'escrow, ibyishimo 80/20, umuryango wa Founding Global Alliance n'ibice byake, na umutungo w'Continuity Custodian. Iri kugira ngo byemere abantu benshi, no gukoresha nk'icyemezo mu kuganira abafatanyabikorwa.
charter_content.license_title: Icyemezo cya Maelsh Pro Ethical Source — ishoramye utagira impamvu z'umurongo
charter_content.license_body: Kode ya Dueli igenda ikomeza mu buryo bwose kugira ngo ibone kugira ngo ibone, n'icyemezo cyo kugira ngo ntibyemewe kugira ngo bikoreshwe kubushake bw'umurongo cyangwa gufata amafaranga y'umurongo, ubushake bwo Maelsh Pro. Gukomeza mu buryo bwose ntacyo cyemezo cyo gukoresha; cyemerera ibyemezo byo kubona no gukora mu byo byemezwe.
charter_content.continuity_title: Icyemezo cya Self-Executing Continuity & Umutungo w'Escrow
charter_content.continuity_body: Icyemezo cya licence kigira icyemezo cyo kugira ngo kibone kugira ngo kibone, ku gahunda gake, umuryango w'ubushakashatsi bw'umurango cyangwa umutungo w'ubushakashatsi w'umurango, wemerera kugira ngo kurema no gukora platformi ku gahura gake, mu buryo bw'umurango, iyo umuyoboro w'ubuyobozi bukorerwa impamvu z'umurango (gufunga, gukora impamvu z'umurango, cyangwa gukurikirana). Icyo kintu cyo kugira ngo kibone:
continuity_items: 80% by'amafaranga y'ibicuruzwa by'umurango agomba kuri abakorerabushake, utagira impamvu.

Icyishimo cya 20% cyagabanywa kuy'umuyoboro w'ubuyobozi, cyangwa kubikwa mu Konte y'umutungo w'escrow mu izina rya Maelsh Pro cyangwa ku murongo w'umurango w'ubuyobozi — kugira ngo byemere imyaka y'ubuyobozi bw'umurango muri byose — kugira ngo bafashe mu gukora kugira ngo bafashe impamvu no gufata.
charter_content.economy_body: 80% by'amafaranga y'ibicuruzwa by'umurango agomba kuri abakorerabushake; 20% igira ngo ibere ishingiye, ubuyobozi no gukora kuri Maelsh Pro. Nta mufatanyabikorwa nta muntu w'umurango nta muntu w'umutungo w'ubushakashatsi w'umurango afite ubushake guhindura iyi myizerere cyangwa gukora ku iyi; ni umurongo wa platformi no kugira ngo byongerwe, kugira ngo byemere.
charter_content.alliance_title: Ikigega cy'Ikigo cya Nyenyeri — imyaka ine y'ikipe, nta nyenyeri, nta kwiha
charter_content.alliance_body: Dueli ikora umwanya utaziguye w'ikipe kubumwe ku baturage bakuru ba teknologiya n'ibigo byose mu masangano akuru atatu (Amerika, Aziya/Ubushinwa na Uburayi) kugira ngo bishyiremo nk'abashinzwe ba mbere. Iki kigega kitagira nyenyeri y'umutungo, kandi nta kwiha kumurikirwa kw'umurimo, amategeko y'umwandiko cyangwa ibisobanuro by'ishoramari. Kuko Dueli yashyizwe hamwe n'ibidukikije by'ikipe ishingiye kugushyira imbere, ariko nta rimwe ryaryo, ikaba itegura ibidukikije by'ikipe kugira ngo bishimire umwanya wa mbere wo kuyitunganya.

tracks.name: Myaka 1 — Umushinzwe wa mbere w'Ikigo cya Mpagarike
tracks.body: Ibigo by'ikigo cya mpagarike, amasangano, na bya cloud (Cloudflare, Google Cloud, AWS, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud): kugenzura mpagarike y'isi, kurengera agace k'umurongo w'umurongo w'umurongo, no kurekura igishushanyo cy'ikigo cy'ishuri.

tracks.name: Myaka 2 — Umushinzwe wa mbere w'Inyandiko Zisobanura & Umushakisha
tracks.body: Amakodisi n'ibikoresho by'abakozi b'amafaranga (GitHub/Microsoft, GitLab, na platforme z'iterambere z'ibyishimo zifatanye na AI): kuringaniza ibishingwe, gushyira mu maboko ahagaragara kandi agumye mu myaka ishize, no kureba abakozi b'amafaranga.

tracks.name: Inzira 3 — Umufatanyabikorwa wa AI Ecosystem y'ububiko
tracks.body: Abayobozi ba AI mu Burengerazuba n'mu Burengerazuba (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Z.ai, Moonshot, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Mistral, Meta, xAI, Qwen/Alibaba): kwitabira mbere mu kurema no gukora ikiganiro cy'umurongo w'abasaba ba AI uhagarariye, no kugira urwego rwa dueli ku kugira imyitozo y'ibyemezo by'ikigo no gufasha platforme n'ubushobozi bwo kugena no kwiga ibisobanuro mu buryo buhoraho.

clarity_items: Iyi nyandiko ni umwanya w'ibyemezo by'ibanze; ntibyemezo ko hari umuryango udaharanira inyungu washinzwe, umuryango ufite amafaranga y'ubushake cyangwa konti y'ibikorwa by'umurikirane. Iyi page ntibyemezo by'amategeko, by'ibyemezo by'umutungo cyangwa by'ikoporasi; ibyemezo byo kugenzura ni icyemezo cy'amategeko cyanditswe mu masoko.
Iyambura kwinjira mu kubanza ni umwanya utemewe w'ikijijwe; ntikugezweho kuri Dueli cyangwa Maelsh Pro kugira ngo batange kompanyi yose, kandi ntibyemerera icyemeranyo cyawe gusa kuba wizeye.

Mitunganyirize y'Igihugu y'Ibyemezo igomba gusa igihe ibibazo byo guhagarara byerekanwe; ntibyemerera umwe muri bagenzi icyemezo cyo kuyobora buri munsi, amafaranga cyangwa umutungo mu gihe cy'ibikorwa by'umwanya.

clauses.title: 1. Ibyemezo by'amashusho, gukoresha mu kwemerera kandi amafaranga y'umurongo
clauses.body: Mu kugerageza cyangwa mu gukina mu bushakashatsi ku Dueli, abakina bashyira imiterere y'umushinga na Maelsh Pro amafaranga yo gukoresha, gukoporora, no gutangiza ikimenyetso cyose cy'umuziki, videwo, na ibyemezo byanditswe ku murikirano - mu buryo bwose cyangwa aho kugira - mu mbugande z'imiterekezo (harimo YouTube) n'umurikirano wose wo gucuranga. Nta muntu wumva ashobora kugerageza kongera cyangwa gukuraho ibitangazwa, n'amafaranga yaturutse mu gucuranga hanze ashobora gukoreshwa n'umushinga nkuko byemejwe kugira ngo ushyikireze, uyobore, no kugena Dueli.
items: Abakina: abakina buriweho kumenyesha no gukora ibyabonetse by'umushinga wabo bwo gukina no kubona inyungu mu mirikirano yabo, mu myanya y'ibitangazwa.

Abareba: abareba barashobora kureba no kumenyesha ibyabonetse by'umushingi w'ubukwe kugira ngo bikoreshemo gusa. Ibyabonetse by'ubukwe by'umurikirano cyangwa by'ubucuruzi byashobora gukurwa mbere gusa n'umushinga.

clauses.title: 2. Nyandiko y'icyemezo cyo gukoresha bisanzwe n'itegeko ryo gukira

items: Icyemezo cyo gukoresha neza: nta kamwe cyangwa umuntu ntashobora gukoresha ibyabonetse by'umushinga by'umushinga kugira ngo byerekeye abantu n'ubumenyi. Ntishoboro gukoreshwa muri gahunda yose ibyemeza cyangwa ibyabuzeitse abaturage.

Ntibyemerewe gukoresha mu bucuruzi utanze idannyugiro: umuntu cyangwa umuryango ntibyemerewe gukoresha amashusho y'inyandiko y'ibanze mu gufata amafaranga cyangwa mu gukora ibyaha by'ubucuruzi utanze idannyugiro ryo hejuru, mbere y'icyemezo, no kunganira na gahunda y'umuryango wibanze (Maelsh Pro).

Gahunda y'ibikorwa by'ubushakashatsi no kugumana (gahunda yo kurinda gukorerwa ibyaha): iyo platforma cyangwa gahunda yayo y'ubuyobozi iyo ikomeje gukorerwa ibibazo by'ibanze biturutse mu karere kandi bigira ingaruka ku kureka ubushakashatsi cyangwa guhinduka mu myizerere y'ibikorwa by'uburenganzira bw'abantu, umuryango w'ubucuruzi bwose butagira amafaranga ukoreshwe amafaranga yayo gusa ukoreshwe platforma y'inyandiko y'ibanze mu buryo butagira ibibazo kugira ngo umurimo wayo ugumane—byemewe imwe ku cyemezo cy'ibanze: gutanga 20% by'amafaranga y'amakarita y'ibicuruziro bya platforma kuyobora umuyobozi w'ibanze (Maelsh Pro) kugira ngo uyobereze mu gukora ibyaha byo kurinda no gusubiza platforma.

clauses.title: 3. Ubwisanzure n'ibyemezo by'ibyatanzwe

Gukoresha imyizerere y'ubucuruzi by'ibyemezo, amakuru y'amakarita y'ibicuruziro cyangwa ibyemezo ntibyemerewe, no gukira mbere gushyirwa mu bikorwa by'ibyemezo by'ibyemezo bisanzwe.

Ibyemezo byavugwemo mu mikino bya abakora imikino bavugamo kandi ntibyemerewe kuba byerekana Dueli cyangwa Maelsh Pro.

obs.title: Igisobanuro: Kamara Virtual ya OBS kubashinzwe
obs.intro: OBS ishobora kugaragaza kamara isanzwe Dueli ishobora gukuramo nk'ikamera isanzwe. Igisobanuro cyerekana inyungu nk'ikirere kuva kuri OBS kuri kamara isanzwe mu mukino.
obs.step_1_d: Ongeramo ibyegeranyo ushaka kugaragaza (screen, umurongo, ikamera) no gukora mu buryo busanzye mbere ushaka kongera.
obs.step_2_d: Mu myanya y'OBS Controls, pressa "Gutangira Kamara Isanzwe". OBS yerekana kamara yitwa "OBS Virtual Camera" mu gisirikare cyawe.
obs.step_3_d: Iyo Dueli ikira ikamera, browser irerekana ikamera izakoreshwa. Hitamo "OBS Virtual Camera" hano — umurimo ntibifite ikigereranya.
obs.step_4_d: Mu mukino, pressa ibendera ry'ikamera kugira ngo uhindure ikamera, no kureka ibisobanuro by'ibanze byerekana imyanya y'OBS.
obs.step_5_d: Ibisobanuro by'ibanze byariho kuri gahunda yawe. Pressa ibendera ryo gutangira kugira ngo umure ikera kuri we na abashyitsi.
obs.alt_d: Ushobora kandi kugaragaza umurongo wa OBS n'ibendera ryo gutangira. Uyu murongo ntibyemerewe ikamera isanzwe cyangwa guhitamo ikamera mu browser.
obs.note_d: Ibendera ry'ikamera hindura ikera no gukira, n'ibendera ryo hindura ikamera hindura ikamera y'imbere na nyuma ku mpande z'ikamera ku mfone — ntibyemerewe guhitamo hagati y'ibikoresho. Ihitamo ry'ibikoresho rihindurwa mu browser cyangwa mu gisirikare.
